name: A ty zhelayesh' stat' esperom?
source:
A bright, sunny day. Beside you is a boy who has for the first time in his life asked you out on... a date? Or perhaps he has something else entirely in mind.

How will a simple conversation in the park, filled with hopes and dreams, unfold?

[Translated from [url=https://elvirien.itch.io/doyouwannabeanesper]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阳光明媚的晴朗一日，走在你身旁的少年平生第一次鼓起勇气约你出来……约会？又或者，他心里盘算的其实是完全不同的另一桩事。

公园里这场充满希望与梦想的寻常交谈，将会迎来怎样的展开？

[译自[url=https://elvirien.itch.io/doyouwannabeanesper]itch.io[/url]]
